steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for MTA-STS and TLS-RPT：Assets, trust boundaries and test fixtures and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付MX政策矩陣、兩組報告計算與逐失敗類型修正紀錄。
在交接件中加入「MTA-STS 與 TLS-RPT：資產、信任邊界與測試資料」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：列出測試MX名稱、政策模式、有效期及憑證名稱；用合成TLS-RPT把失敗分為連線、名稱與信任鏈問題，與DMARC內容層判斷分開。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：列出測試MX名稱、政策模式、有效期及憑證名稱；用合成TLS-RPT把失敗分為連線、名稱與信任鏈問題，與DMARC內容層判斷分開。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver MX policy tests, two report calculations and remediation records by failure type.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for MTA-STS and TLS-RPT：Assets, trust boundaries and test fixtures: List test MX names, policy mode, lifetime and certificate names; classify synthetic TLS-RPT failures into connection, name and trust-chain issues, separately from DMARC. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: List test MX names, policy mode, lifetime and certificate names; classify synthetic TLS-RPT failures into connection, name and trust-chain issues, separately from DMARC. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。列出測試MX名稱、政策模式、有效期及憑證名稱；用合成TLS-RPT把失敗分為連線、名稱與信任鏈問題，與DMARC內容層判斷分開。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. List test MX names, policy mode, lifetime and certificate names; classify synthetic TLS-RPT failures into connection, name and trust-chain issues, separately from DMARC. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.

steps.checkEn: List test MX names, policy mode, lifetime and certificate names; classify synthetic TLS-RPT failures into connection, name and trust-chain issues, separately from DMARC. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: MTA-STS發布接收郵件的TLS要求，TLS-RPT提供傳輸失敗的彙總回報格式。
knowledge.textEn: MTA-STS publishes TLS requirements for mail reception, while TLS-RPT defines aggregate transport-failure reports.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 列出測試MX名稱、政策模式、有效期及憑證名稱；用合成TLS-RPT把失敗分為連線、名稱與信任鏈問題，與DMARC內容層判斷分開。
knowledge.textEn: List test MX names, policy mode, lifetime and certificate names; classify synthetic TLS-RPT failures into connection, name and trust-chain issues, separately from DMARC.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 傳輸成功率=成功的報告sessions/報告總sessions；報告涵蓋率需另外追蹤，缺報告不代表成功。
knowledge.textEn: Transport success rate equals successful reported sessions divided by reported sessions; track reporting coverage separately because missing reports do not prove success.
